# infisical_pam_account_ssh (Resource)

Create and manage SSH accounts in Infisical PAM. The connection is tested when the account is created or its connection changes. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

data "infisical_gateway" "main" {
  name = "prod-gateway"
}

resource "infisical_pam_folder" "linux_team" {
  name = "linux-team"
}

resource "infisical_pam_account_template" "ssh" {
  name         = "ssh-default"
  account_type = "ssh"
  gateway_id   = data.infisical_gateway.main.id
}

resource "infisical_pam_account_ssh" "web01" {
  name        = "web01-root"
  folder_id   = infisical_pam_folder.linux_team.id
  template_id = infisical_pam_account_template.ssh.id

  connection_details = {
    host = "10.0.1.10"
    port = 22
  }

  credentials = {
    auth_method = "public-key"
    username    = "root"
    private_key = var.web01_private_key
  }
}

variable "web01_private_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_details` (Attributes) How to reach the SSH target. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_details))
- `credentials` (Attributes) The credentials of the account. Secrets are never read back, so changes made outside of Terraform, such as rotation, aren't detected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `folder_id` (String) The ID of the folder the account is in. Changing it moves the account.
- `name` (String) The name of the account, unique in its folder. Must be lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, at most 64 characters.
- `template_id` (String) The ID of the account template the account uses, which must be a `ssh` template.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description of the account.
- `gateway_id` (String) The ID of the gateway to connect through instead of the template's.
- `gateway_pool_id` (String) The ID of the gateway pool to connect through instead of the template's.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the account.

<a id="nestedatt--connection_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_details`

Required:

- `host` (String) The hostname or IP address of the SSH server.

Optional:

- `port` (Number) The port of the SSH server. Defaults to 22.


<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Required:

- `auth_method` (String) How the account authenticates: `password`, `public-key`, or `certificate`. With `certificate`, the server must trust the account's Infisical SSH CA: once the account exists, get its public key from `GET /api/v1/pam/accounts/{id}/ssh-ca-public-key` and add it to the server's `TrustedUserCAKeys`. Creation doesn't check this trust, so sessions fail until it is set up.
- `username` (String) The username to log in as.

Optional:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password, for the `password` auth method.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) The PEM-encoded private key, for the `public-key` auth method.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the SSH PAM account by its ID.
# Secrets are never read back, so set the credentials in the configuration after importing.
terraform import infisical_pam_account_ssh.example <account_id>
```
